args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18) since its latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback to v2.3.0.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api healthy (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 in all regions.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so if you later want to redeploy it, that would require change-manager approval per policy.
